1739-2363-4659-5224.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1} due to Herald's Horn, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3558-5006-5231-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crookshank Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
3558-5006-5231-8170.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crookshank Kobolds spell. Then, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, adding {R}
Repeat.

483-1339-1832-5231.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
483-1339-1832-5231.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}
When the Insect dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

141-8095-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-8095-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
141-8095-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3908-6558.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3908-6558.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Spark Double and Naga Fleshcrafter each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Naga Fleshcrafter trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3908-6558.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

443-1263-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-5003-7703.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scion Summoner, adding {C}{C}.
When Scion Summoner dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Scion Summoner from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Scion Summoner enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1894-2523-2869.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Bile Urchin that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Repeat using the Bile Urchin token

671-4186-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-4186-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

206-1270-1563-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three creature tokens.
Activate two tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2034-3372-6006-7296.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
2034-3372-6006-7296.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {C}{C}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

527-1115-5900.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Selvala.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1545-2034-3490-4017.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1545-2034-3490-4017.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

2866-3518-4986-5315.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

339-647-677-2921.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

813-2103-3306.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Slip On the Ring.
813-2103-3306.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Slip On the Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

856-2099-5631-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

2097-4508-4875-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

5541-6085-6086-6087.notablePrerequisites: Bazaar Trader and Sentinel do not have summoning sickness.
5541-6085-6086-6087.description:
Activate Bazaar Trader by tapping it, giving control of Altanak to an opponent.
Declare Sentinel as an attacker, forcing Altanak to block it due to Lure.
Holding priority, activate Sentinel an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Altanak.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

1597-2608-4499.notablePrerequisites: Gyre Sage does not have summoning sickness, and has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
1597-2608-4499.description:
Activate Gyre Sage by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Gyre Sage.
Repeat.

141-1223-2921.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one creature on the battlefield.
141-1223-2921.description:
Cast Fake Your Own Death by paying {1}{B}, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Fake Your Own Death, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Fake Your Own Death.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield and creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bartolomé del Presidio abilities, putting that many +1/+1 counters on it.

2060-3525-4929-5462.manaNeeded: {6} available plus an additional {1} if you have no colored mana
2060-3525-4929-5462.notablePrerequisites: Raucous Entertainer does not have summoning sickness.
2060-3525-4929-5462.description:
Cast Crystalline Crawler by paying {4}, using at least one colored mana if available.
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {2}.
If Crystalline Crawler has a +1/+1 counter on it, activate its first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Activate Raucous Entertainer by paying {1} and tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler, Cryptic Trilobite and any other creature you control the entered the battlefield this turn.
If you have no {C} in your mana pool, activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Raucous Entertainer.
Repeat from step 4.

1369-3995-4306-5112.notablePrerequisites:
Mairsil does not have summoning sickness.
Your devotion to blue is at least three.
1369-3995-4306-5112.description:
Activate Mairsil using Nyx Lotus' ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mairsil using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Activate Mairsil using Quicksilver Elemental's ability by paying {U}, causing it to gain all activated abilities of itself until end of turn.
Repeat.

1170-1849-2055-2175-3390.description:
Activate The Face of Boe by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast Lotus Bloom from your hand.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking The Face of Boe.
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Auriok Salvagers by paying {1}{W}, returning Lotus Bloom to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2034-3263-3996.notablePrerequisites: Twilight Drover has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-3263-3996.description:
Activate Twilight Drover by paying {3} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Spirit tokens, adding {4}.
When the Spirits die, Twilight Drover triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Twilight Drover.
Repeat.

1823-2773-2864-4050.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature with toughness six or less.
You do not control an Army.
1823-2773-2864-4050.description:
Activate That Which Was Taken by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a divinity counter on a creature an opponent controls with toughness six or less.
Activate Fall of Cair Andros by paying {7}{R}, dealing seven damage to the creature that has a divinity counter on it.
Fall of Cair Andros triggers, creating a 0/0 Army and putting at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Army enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Army, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Warstorm Surge trigger, dealing 1 damage to the creature with a divinity counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, with a Warstorm Surge trigger on the stack, you may use Fall of Cair Andros' ability to deal infinite damage to the creature with a divinity counter on it, thus causing the Army to have infinite +1/+1 counters on it, which causes the Warstorm Surge trigger to deal infinite damage to any target.

2493-3603-4050-4485.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, targeting Archaeomancer.
Docent of Perfection triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Wizard token.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Human Wizard, adding {W}.
Repeat.

3799-4090-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to you and a creature. The damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to Stuffy Doll instead due to Pariah.
Stuffy Doll triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to the named player
3799-4090-5109.notes: If Stuffy Doll has you chosen as the player, this combo starts an infinite loop that ends the game in a draw.

3750-3809-4076.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three creatures in your party.
Burakos does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Burakos.
3750-3809-4076.description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block and kill it.
Burakos triggers, creating at least three Treasure tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose at least three life.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

739-937-2749.description:
During your upkeep, activate Wall of Blood by paying 1 life, giving Wall of Blood +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 1 until you have zero life.
Activate Magus of the Mirror by tapping and sacrificing it, exchanging your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
